'''2000 European Championship''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. [[Martin Akesson]] won. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs for runner-up [[Maarten Rossou]]. The recovered [[Blessed Souls]] homepage listed Akesson (Sweden) with decks Missing, and Maarten Rousseau (Netherlands) with all fields Missing.<ref name="bs">[https://web.archive.org/web/20201114131040id_/https://t.co/RCNHte1tcY SWCCG - Database], Blessed Souls (Wayback 14 November 2020)</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Dates:''' August 2000

== Trandosite decklists ==

Alex Tennet's pages say he played these decks "at the European Championship weekend in Brussells". Trandosite first captured them on 17 October 2000. The 2000 European Championship weekend was held in Brussels in August 2000 (see [[2000 Brussels Grand Slam]]), so this is that event.<ref name="ds124">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds124.htm The Emperor's Hand], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027092257/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds124.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ls127">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls127.htm Skywalker Projections], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027103424/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls127.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
